spirits.name: War Economy
spirits.description: Industry has been placed on a war footing; the civilian economy is subordinated to armament production.

spirits.name: National Unity
spirits.description: With the public divided, a national unity government rallies the country behind the state.

spirits.name: Mobilisation Drive
spirits.description: A mass recruitment campaign brings volunteers and conscripts into the ranks.

spirits.name: Fortress Doctrine
spirits.description: The army plans around fortified defensive lines and prepared positions.

spirits.name: Scientific Institutes
spirits.description: A network of state research institutes accelerates applied science and engineering.

spirits.name: Officer Purge Aftermath
spirits.description: Political purges have hollowed out the officer corps; command initiative suffers.

spirits.name: Colonial Administration
spirits.description: A sprawling colonial bureaucracy channels manpower and resources to the metropole.

spirits.name: Trade Dependency
spirits.description: The economy depends on foreign markets and shipping lanes it does not control.

spirits.name: Heavy Industrial Base
spirits.description: A large pre-war industrial base of steelworks, machine shops and shipyards anchors the economy.

spirits.name: General Staff Reform
spirits.description: A reformed general staff improves operational planning and staff work.
